summary: vanexa-agent daemon exposes installer host to remote shell execution via hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package's agent daemon connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches messages received from that relay into an LLM tool loop whose available tools include shell execution (spawning /bin/bash on Unix or cmd.exe on Windows with arbitrary commands) and a persistent terminal REPL. Messages arriving from the relay drive command execution on the machine running the daemon, giving whoever controls the relay endpoint a remote shell on the installer's host. In addition, when no API key is configured the AI client silently forwards chat messages, tool schemas, and a deviceHash to a second hardcoded author-controlled endpoint at vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, despite the README advertising a BYOK / no-middleman model.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
